title: CPR in microgravity (weightless only; partial gravity is not covered by published guidance)

steps.text: Start chest compressions with the Evetts-Russomano (ER) method. In immediate Basic Life Support it is the chest compression method of choice, and it does not require the patient to be restrained.

source.guideline: Hinkelbein J, et al. Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) during spaceflight - a guideline for CPR in microgravity from the German Society of Aerospace Medicine (DGLRM) and the European Society of Aerospace Medicine Space Medicine Group (ESAM-SMG). Scand J Trauma Resusc Emerg Med. 2020;28:108. doi:10.1186/s13049-020-00793-y
